title: PraisonAI CodeAgent runs LLM-generated Python unsandboxed even with sandbox=True
attacker_story: An app builds a PraisonAI CodeAgent and runs code it generates: code = agent.generate(prompt); agent.execute(code). The agent asks its LLM (via litellm) to write code and returns the completion verbatim; execute() routes it to _execute_python, which in 1.6.77 writes the string to a temp .py and runs `python <tmp>` in a subprocess with the FULL parent environment (os.environ.copy()), no AST validation and no import restrictions -- even when CodeConfig(sandbox=True) is set. A prompt injection in the agent's input, a tool result, or ingested content steers the model into emitting code that runs on the host and exfiltrates every environment secret (CVE-2026-61447 / GHSA-2xv2-w8cq-5gxw). No model is needed to prove it: the scripted model stands in for the completion the injection would elicit; the finding is that the framework executes model-authored code with the sandbox flag ignored. Fixed in 1.6.78 by routing through a real sandbox (tools/python_tools.execute_code, sandbox_mode honoured).

scripted_model.interface: a fake litellm module plugged into CodeAgent.litellm; its completion() returns the attacker-chosen code as response.choices[0].message.content -- the framework's own LLM call site
scripted_model.behavior: returns the fixture code verbatim, ignoring the prompt; proves the framework runs model-authored code with no enforced sandbox independent of model behaviour
scripted_model.may_assume: that some untrusted content could make a real code-writing model emit this completion -- in-shape output for a CodeAgent, i.e. a block of Python the agent is built to execute; nothing more
scripted_model.may_not_assume: no privileged config (sandbox is left at its default True -- the advisory's point is that it is ignored), no network, no attacker code already on disk; only that the model's output reaches execute()

canary.mechanism: the executed Python runs os.system('echo <nonce> > /tmp/chainlab_canary'); oracle reads the file and checks the per-trial nonce
